description: §22.5.4 (S482) — a `reflect()` entry carries all four `TypeInfo` members; the one its kind does not carry is the empty list. `reflect(Color).fields` on an enum is `[]`, so `.fields.length` is 0 and the compile-time block compiles clean (never a TypeError on an absent member).
rationale: §22.5.4 (S482): "Every entry SHALL carry all four `TypeInfo` members: `fields` of an entry whose kind is not \"struct\", and `variants` of an entry whose kind is not \"enum\", SHALL be the empty list — never absent." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-typeinfo-empty-list — "an empty list. It keeps the `TypeInfo` type honest … `kind` still says which list is meaningful".
